info.title: Raven Web RPC
info.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 contract for the gateway's web channel: the raven.* namespace served by raven/web_rpc over ws://<host>:<port>/ws and spoken by ui-webui/service. The terminal-dialect methods the same dispatcher also serves (system.*, turn.*, subagents.instance*) are declared in rpc-schema/openrpc.json, not here. Pydantic v2 models live in raven/web_rpc/models.py; drift is caught in CI by tests/test_web_rpc_schema_match.py.

agents.description: Configured third-party sub-agent entries, validated config dicts (by alias).

schema.description: Full replacement list of third-party sub-agent config entries.
Which configured entry or preset to test, by name only.

instances.description: Registry rows, reconciled against what is still alive on the agent loop.

run.description: One DAG run's structure and per-node state, from its run dir.

node.description: One node's rendered prompt and (truncated) output.

model.description: The session's own override, or null when unset.

default.description: agents.defaults.model, what an unset session routes on.

schema.description: Model id to pin, or null to clear the override.

workdir.description: The session's own override, or null when unset.

default.description: The directory the next turn would run in without an override.

schema.description: Absolute directory to pin, or null to clear the override.

config.description: Current config, dotted-path -> value, secrets redacted.

qr.description: Login QR as a PNG data URI, or null when none is pending.

qr_text.description: Raw scan payload when the gateway cannot rasterise a PNG.

rebind.description: Null for a channel that does not offer rebinding.

phase.description: idle | waiting | scanned | confirmed | failed | cancelled.

refreshes.description: Codes reissued so far, against max_refreshes.

code_age_s.description: Seconds since the current code was issued; null when none is up.

detail.description: Why it failed, when it did: expired | no_token | error.

reason.description: '' when started; else not_running | already_rebinding | unsupported.

phase.description: idle | waiting | scanned | confirmed | failed | cancelled.
idle | waiting | scanned | confirmed | failed | cancelled.

connected.description: Three-valued: null means the channel does not report a pairing at all.

items.description:
One configurable tool row.

Two shapes share this model: the web-search row carries ``maxResults``, and
a media row carries the model/base fields plus ``configured`` (a media tool
the user never configured stays off even with a chat key present). The
variant fields are optional rather than split into two models because the
page renders one list from both.

schema.description:
Union of the local-catalog shape and the hub-fetch shape.

A local/installed skill carries path/description/tags/files; a hub catalog
item that was never installed carries version. ``skillMd`` and ``name`` are
the only fields both shapes always produce.

items.description: Hub catalog entries, passed through as-is.

removed.description: The skill folder that was deleted.

backend.description: memory.backend actually in force, or null (native memory).

schema.description: Sibling section whose stored key to copy.
Provider slug whose Credentials-page key to copy.

servers.description: Configured entries with live state merged in (connected, tools).

JsonValue.description: Recursive JSON value type. Implemented as an unconstrained object in JSON Schema; downstream Pydantic uses typing.Any.
